facts.business: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited is an integrated sugarcane processing company producing sugar, ethanol, speciality spirits, renewable power, and bio-fuels through a circular, sustainable value chain.

segments.name: Renewable power / co-generation (from bagasse and other by-products)
Bio-fuels and spirits (ethanol from molasses and grain as feedstocks)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Near-term capital allocation will remain measured, with limited incremental capex and a focus on efficiency-led investments, ensuring resilience in a policy-driven sector.

key_risks: Cane price increase while ethanol price remained unchanged
Lower-than-expected cane yields leading to decline in sugar production
Decline in net sugar production not resulting in commensurate increase in sugar prices
Inventory valuation risk due to significant judgement in determination of COP and NRV
Fluctuation in domestic and international selling prices
Minimum sale price, monthly quota, and molasses policy of State Government
